scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lurelog/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @lurelog/server" "npm run dev -w @lurelog/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lurelog/shared && npm run build -w @lurelog/server && npm run build -w @lurelog/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lurelog/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lurelog/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @lurelog/shared && npm run seed -w @lurelog/server
